truck.template: Extreme wide side-on shot of {subject} filling the ENTIRE width of the frame edge to edge — front bumper at the far left edge, tailgate at the far right edge, the truck large and close so it dominates the whole horizontal frame — parked {setting}, {light}, {atmosphere}, slow subtle camera pan along the flank, {subject_state}
truck.note: PRIMARY truck bible (Eric pref 2026-07-03): MiniMax/hailuo t2v, crispier consistency, 5-way crop for cost. One wide SIDE-PROFILE generation -> 5 standalone 9:16 clips (grille/front-wheel, front-cab, cab, bed, tailgate). ~$0.28/gen = ~$0.056/clip. Side-shot composition is what makes the 5-crop work in-algo.
